test.description:

* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Selecting available dropdown values
* Removing field value
* Changing selected values across supported views
* Verifying only one value can be selected at a time
* Verifying selected value is displayed correctly across all supported views
* Correct dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

rag.text:
Test: TC-6163 — SPM - OKR - Updating Select custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating Select custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Select custom field values
* Selecting available dropdown values
* Removing field value
* Changing selected values across supported views
* Verifying only one value can be selected at a time
* Verifying selected value is displayed correctly across all supported views
* Correct dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Select custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Select fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6163 SPM - OKR - Updating Select custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Select field
   Expected: Select custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "High"
* Objective - "Medium"
* Key Result - "Low"
4. Navigate to the Strategic theme Select custom field and click on field value
   Expected: Dropdown with available Select custom field values is displayed correctly:

* High
* Medium
* Low

Clear button is visible
5. Click on Clear button
   Expected: Dropdown closed and value disappear form Select field in Overview
6. Navigate to the Key result Select custom field and change the value
   Data: newValue: Medium
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
7. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Select field is visible with correct value.
8. Navigate to the Key result Select custom field and change the value
   Data: newValue: Low
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
9. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Select field is visible with correct value.
10. Navigate to the Key result Select custom field and change the value
   Data: newValue: High
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
